name: ZoLaiGPT Chat Preview
tagline: A browser-based workspace demo with local threads, notes and scripted replies.
description: The Chat Preview shows how a ZoLaiGPT conversation workspace could feel. It runs entirely in your browser and answers with prewritten, source-based demo replies. It is not connected to a live AI model, and it does not send your messages to any server.
features: Conversation threads, search and a collapsible sidebar
Scripted demo replies drawn from existing website content (English, Myanmar, Zomi)
Markdown rendering, copy and transcript export
Personal notes canvas and local text-file preview (not analysed by AI)
requirements: A current version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari

notes: Spatial chat workspace published at /chat/ as a clearly labelled local demo
No live AI provider, account system or analytics connected

screenshots.alt: ZoLaiGPT Chat Preview on a desktop browser
screenshots.caption: Desktop workspace (captured from the actual /chat/ page)

screenshots.alt: ZoLaiGPT Chat Preview on a 390px-wide mobile viewport
screenshots.caption: Mobile layout at 390px (browser emulation, not a physical device)

installation: No installation is needed. Open the preview in your browser.

faq.a: No. Replies are prewritten demo content. A live AI service would require a secured server-side backend, which is not connected.
Only in the current browser tab. Refreshing the page clears conversations, notes and attachments.

privacyNote: The preview runs locally in your browser. See the website Privacy Policy (draft) for details.
